folder_not_self.name: folder_not_self
folder_not_self.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

edge_confidence.name: edge_confidence

graph_node_reference.name: graph_node_reference
graph_node_reference.value: (kind = 'note' AND note_id IS NOT NULL AND source_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'source' AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND note_id IS NULL) OR (kind IN ('concept', 'topic') AND note_id IS NULL AND source_id IS NULL)
